description: Schema definition used to create the Restaurant table (layer 1/9 of the Poutine League Dataverse data model build-out). Source of truth: ARCHITECTURE.md §1 (Data model).

table.purpose: A Montreal restaurant/place where a poutine was found.

columns.notes: Primary name column, auto-created with the table.
Geocoded latitude. Precision bumped from SDK default (2) to 6 for geo accuracy; MinValue/MaxValue set to valid latitude bounds.
Geocoded longitude. Precision bumped from SDK default (2) to 6 for geo accuracy; MinValue/MaxValue set to valid longitude bounds.
City area / neighborhood (e.g., Plateau-Mont-Royal, Mile End).

creationMethod.precisionFixup: Web API PUT on EntityDefinitions(...)/Attributes(...)/Microsoft.Dynamics.CRM.DecimalAttributeMetadata (SDK does not expose Precision/MinValue/MaxValue control at creation time)
